The best answer is **A, equitable servitude**. The recorded subdivision plan placed a land-use limit (school only) on the 10-acre lot, and the brochure shows the lot buyers relied on it as part of a common development scheme, which is the usual basis for enforcing such a restriction against later owners. The main alternative is B, since "restrictive covenant" is the broader term and equitable servitudes are one form of it.

CONFIDENCE: 55
